description: Minimal loader plugin whose only job is to require _inventory/seed/apollo-seed.php so the idempotent JSON-driven seeder actually executes. Created 2026-08-29 to solve a real autoload gap: the seeder lived outside wp-content/plugins/*/*.php, so WordPress never scanned it and its admin_init hook never registered — the script documented its own usage but could never run.

$tooling.trigger: admin_init, gated on ?apollo_seed=1 (dry run) and &write=1 (actually writes)
$tooling.idempotency: _apollo_seed_key post meta is the dedupe key — re-running never duplicates rows
$tooling.default_behaviour: DRY RUN. Writing requires an explicit &write=1.

$why_it_stays_active: Left active deliberately: it is admin-gated, dry-run by default, and idempotent, so it is safe to leave in place for future re-seeds. If that judgement changes, deactivating it is harmless — nothing else depends on it.
$registry_gap_closed: Created on disk 2026-08-29 but had no registry entry until 2026-08-31. Found by doctor.js.
